§605-15 Venue. Actions for violations of section 605-14 shall be brought in the circuit court for the judicial circuit in which the violation is alleged to have been committed.

§605-15  [OLD]  REPEALED.  L 1975, c 45, pt of §2.

 

 

     §605-15  Venue.  Actions for violations of section 605-14 shall be brought in the circuit court for the judicial circuit in which the violation is alleged to have been committed. [L 1975, c 45, pt of §2]
